title: Domain Entity
description: JSON Schema for Domain entity in customer workspace. Domains are logical, business-oriented subdivisions for organizing Data Products.

project_id.description: Project that contains this domain (set when a bundle save writes the file)

owner_user_id.description: User ID of the domain owner

parent_domain_id.description: Parent domain ID for hierarchical organization

is_council.description: True if this is the Data Council domain

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when domain was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when domain was last updated

created_by.description: User ID who created the domain

updated_by.description: User ID who last updated the domain

deleted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when domain was deleted (soft delete)
